[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on fixing their bike and offered to help find bike trails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided four bike trail recommendations: Riverfront Trail, Lakefront Path, Creek Trail, and Park Connector Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Riverfront Trail is a 12-mile trail running along the river with stunning views of the city skyline.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lakefront Path is a 7-mile trail surrounding a lake with picturesque views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Creek Trail is a 4-mile trail following a creek with urban and natural scenery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Park Connector Trail is a 2-mile trail linking two parks with wooded areas and a small lake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended checking trail conditions and using online resources like TrailLink or MapMyRide.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided several bike shops and cafes along the Riverfront Trail: River City Cycles, The Coffee Pedaler, Riverwalk Cafe, and The Bike Hub.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] River City Cycles offers bike rentals, repairs, and accessories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Coffee Pedaler serves coffee, pastries, and sandwiches, and has a bike repair station.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Riverwalk Cafe offers breakfast and lunch options with a patio overlooking the river.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bike Hub provides bike rentals, repairs, and a small cafe with snacks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided safety tips for riding to the dance studio, including checking the route, following bike lanes, and being visible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested using a mapping app for turn-by-turn directions and real-time traffic updates.
